raw_sections.summary:
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Fund Accounting professional with 8+ years of experience supporting global asset management operations across EMEA and APAC markets. Strong expertise in NAV calculation, fund accounting controls, corporate actions, derivatives, and custody operations.
Experienced in working with onshore Ireland, Germany and China teams in high-volume, deadline-driven environments. Known for accuracy, ownership, and strong stakeholder communication.
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Northern Trust – Bengaluru, India Technical Coordinator – Fund Accounting Reconciliation Feb 2023 – May 2025
Performed and reviewed end-to-end NAV reconciliations including cash, positions,

income, and FX. Investigated complex breaks, performed root cause analysis, and coordinated with onshore Ireland teams for resolution.
Conducted quality assurance (QA) reviews to ensure adherence to internal controls and regulatory standards.
Supported fund transitions and process stabilization during implementation of a new operating model.
Prepared and maintained SOPs and client documentation to support audits and operational consistency.
Performed trade capture and validation of investment transactions by recording capital calls, distributions, subscriptions, and fund movements, ensuring accurate transaction booking, reconciliation, and downstream NAV reporting
Société Générale Securities Services – GSC, Bengaluru Fund Accountant (Analyst) Sep 2019 – Feb 2023
Supported daily NAV calculation for mutual and shadow funds in an EMEA setup. • Processed subscriptions, redemptions, and custody fee bookings. • Managed corporate actions by validating events against custody and vendor data. • Handled derivatives processing including futures, options, and rollovers. • Investigated pricing, holdings, and corporate action discrepancies and coordinated with Middle Office.
Ensured timely NAV delivery and escalated risks proactively.
State Street Corporation – Bengaluru, India Associate – Security Pricing Oct 2016 – May 2018
Provided daily market prices for equities, bonds, futures, and options. • Supported migration of security pricing operations from China to India.
Reviewed and resolved pricing exceptions within SLA timelines. • Coordinated with Fund Accounting, Corporate Actions, and ETD teams.
